failure_summary.description: RNALinker is single-target; multi-gene panel analyses need a loop pattern not documented

edits.content:
## Multi-gene panel pattern

For an immune signature of N genes, run RNALinker per gene and aggregate:

```python
import pandas as pd
panel = ["CD8A", "GZMB", "PRF1", "IFNG"]
scores = []
for g in panel:
    high_mask = rna[:, g].X.toarray().ravel() > rna[:, g].X.mean()
    rna.obs[f"{g}_high"] = high_mask
    linker = RNALinker(agg_features=agg_features, others=rna)
    linker.score(groupby=f"{g}_high", score_group=True,
                 test_method="wilcoxon", n_features=100,
                 key_added=f"assoc_{g}")
    scores.append(agg_features.obs[f"assoc_{g}"])
panel_score = pd.concat(scores, axis=1).mean(axis=1)
agg_features.obs["panel_assoc"] = panel_score
```
